name: Sparo PPT Production Engine
description: Atomic Manuscript, AI-authored Design Case and VisualDocument pages, capability-aware semantic and visual review, history, and validated PowerPoint export.

capabilities.title: Sparo PPT Production Engine
capabilities.description: Create and validate the current PPT Live presentation through the non-compatible manuscript-first protocol.

actions.name: initializeWork
actions.description: Create one human-visible PPT folder for a newly created workspace Work.

actions.name: attachWorkObject
actions.description: Bind a new Work runtime to an existing PPT Live WorkObject without copying content.

actions.name: inspect
actions.description: Return the current parsed Manuscript, revisions, Design Case, visual state, ReviewCoverage, and deterministic RuleViolations.

actions.name: getDocument
actions.description: Read the managed manuscript or speaker script for the Surface editor.

actions.name: commitPresentationDocument
actions.description: Validate a structured ManuscriptContract payload, serialize canonical Markdown, and atomically reset visual pages bound to the previous Manuscript.

actions.name: commitPresentationManuscript
actions.description: Validate and atomically commit complete user-edited canonical Markdown, then reset visual pages bound to the previous Manuscript.

actions.name: commitSpeakerScript
actions.description: CAS-save a speaker-only Markdown revision without changing visual production state.

actions.name: reviewPresentationManuscript
actions.description: Prepare or commit one whole-manuscript AI review while keeping RuleViolations separate from ReviewFindings.

actions.name: setPresentationSystem
actions.description: Atomically replace the complete PresentationSystem and invalidate Design Case approval.

actions.name: getAsset
actions.description: Return one committed visual asset for the Surface.

actions.name: renderDesignCase
actions.description: Render exactly three complete AI-authored visual pages based on the current Manuscript and PresentationSystem.

actions.name: decideDesignCase
actions.description: Record explicit user or capability-eligible multimodal AI approval or revision feedback.

actions.name: prepareVisualAssets
actions.description: Prepare the approved case's grounded workspace or semantic SVG assets in one manifest-bound operation.

actions.name: generateSlideVisual
actions.description: Compile and commit one complete AI-authored VisualDocument page in current Manuscript order without injecting or string-matching content.

actions.name: editVisual
actions.description: Apply a direct user node, order, or selection edit to current visual state.

actions.name: reviewDeck
actions.description: Prepare a multimodal/text inspection bundle or commit deck-wide ReviewFindings and ReviewCoverage.

actions.name: undo
actions.description: Restore the previous atomic design or visual state.

actions.name: export
actions.description: Export the exact passed current review as a validated PPTX package.

tools.name: SparoPptDeck
tools.description: Produce a manuscript-first PPT Live deck and export its reviewed VisualDocument.
